# AMN Healthcare

> > AMN Healthcare is the nation's leading healthcare workforce solutions provider, offering staffing, managed services, and compliance resources for nursing, physician, allied health, and language services professionals.

AMN Healthcare connects healthcare facilities with travel nurses, locum tenens physicians, allied health professionals, and certified interpreters while providing workforce strategy consulting, compensation benchmarking, and regulatory compliance toolkits. The company specializes in contingent labor management, international recruitment programs, and innovative solutions like teletherapy platforms for schools.

## Key Topics

- Travel Nursing
- Locum Tenens Physicians
- Healthcare Staffing Solutions
- Contingent Labor Management
- Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC)
- BLS & ACLS Certification
- Physician Assistant Specialties
- Language Services & Section 1557 Compliance
- Allied Health Professionals
- Radiology & Medical Imaging
- Interventional Radiology
- Telehealth & Teletherapy
- Workforce Strategy
- International Direct-Hire Programs
- Compensation Benchmarking

- [How a Northern Health System Saved $30M](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/amn-insights/nursing/whitepapers/how-a-northern-health-system-saved-$30m-with-an-international-direct-hire-workforce-strategy): Case study: $30M savings via International Direct-Hire nursing program
- [Resilience Is Not a Strategy](https://www.amnhealthcare.com/amn-insights/nursing/blog/resilience-is-not-a-strategy): John Palmer on nurse burnout, toxic stress, and system redesign needs
